FAQ

Common questions.

What kinds of policies can it write?
Any you name — remote work, PTO, IT and computer use, dress code, social media, safety, expenses and more.
Is it legally compliant?
It's a well-organized starting draft, not legal advice. Employment law differs by state, so have it reviewed before you use it.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Policy Generator is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
